representation_decisions.reason: AuraButton intrinsic is a Button, hence a Frame. Frame provider creates this intrinsic and passes its public object table to the initialization callback before applying access restrictions.
Public shared methods SetUnit validates a string, SetEnabled updates registrations and aura state, IsEnabled normalizes to boolean, and UpdateAllAuras is overridable.

Aura container Lua runs in a secure environment, while intrinsic/template XML and the explicit inbound facade load globally. The type describes public native instance methods, not access to private addon implementation globals.
AuraContainer intrinsic derives Frame; public AuraContainerInboundMixin delegates through its forbidden partition and owns enabled/unit defaults.
Public/native flow layout API owns spacing and geometry; group layout field validation is in CustomAuraContainer.
Initializer receives the created aura frame public object table before access restrictions are applied; callbacks do not grant permission to inspect later secret aura state.
Default group options make candidate filters, initializer and layout optional; default maxFrameCount is infinity and frame initialization batches are ten.

Validates and copies optional caller group options, candidates and group layout; AddAuraGroup accepts unique nonempty key and native filter string and returns no values. maxFrameCount uses its numeric Lua carrier, but native validation requires a nonnegative integer or positive infinity. Candidate/geometry values remain native validated. Adding a group introduces the UntrustedLayoutScriptExecution forbidden aspect.
CustomAuraContainerTemplate instantiates AuraContainer with CustomAuraContainerInboundMixin on the public partition and private implementation separately.
ManagedAuraContainerSharedMixin provides the concrete UpdateAllAuras implementation inherited by CustomAuraContainerSharedMixin.
ChatFrameTemplate is a ScrollingMessageFrame mixed with ChatFrameMixin.
ChatFrameMixin.AddMessage forwards arguments through ScrollingMessageFrameSecureMixin.
Invokes registered callbacks with trimmed message and the edit-box receiver; second argument remains optional for addon direct invocation.
Sets DEFAULT_CHAT_FRAME to ChatFrame1.
Initialization gives each ChatTypeInfo entry public numeric r/g/b fields; other chat configuration fields remain outside the consumed color contract.
Defines the string-keyed chat-type table including RAID_WARNING before color initialization.
General user-addon slash command callback registry is intentionally global and string-keyed.
Legacy wrapper forwards text/color/displayTime to RaidWarningUtil; only exists when loadDeprecationFallbacks is enabled, so consumers retain runtime presence checks.
Base dialog getters and open caller-defined mode tables; returned layout reuses native EditModeLayoutInfo.
Declares named dialog Frames and SaveAndProceedButton.
Manager exposes native layout records/arrays and dirty-state methods; active layout/preset may be absent.
Declares manager Frame and its SaveChangesButton/RevertAllChangesButton native buttons.
Adds providers with OnAdded; acquires template-dependent native pins, invokes OnAcquired with arbitrary arguments and returns the common pin surface.
Mixin lifecycle, optional scaling bounds, position/inset, frame-level index and passthrough button callbacks; GetMap can be nil before OnAdded or after OnRemoved.

At69 and98 Blizzard passes the string GameFontHighlight to fontString/EditBox SetFontObject. Questie Widget/UIType/Font.lua independently defines FontObject as string|Font; native SimpleFont-only argument metadata underdescribes that carrier.
At1981-1982 menu release executes each callback with the menu proxy and closeReason; stale supplemental annotation omits second argument.
AcquireUnitFrame creates the child via the driver and assigns UnitFrame; ReleaseUnitFrame clears it to nil. The header identifies the child as NamePlateUnitFrameMixin.

BaseNamePlateUnitFrameTemplate is a Button with NamePlateUnitFrameMixin; ordinary and forbidden NamePlateUnitFrame templates inherit it. The static shape does not grant permission to read a forbidden instance.
Factory returns uiMapID, Vector2D position and optional z; all three constructors retained.
Declares the global frame instance.
Forwarded warning text, color and optional display time are passed to the warning frame.
Validates native frames and snippets; rejects forbidden receivers, requires explicit protection for wrap header, optional post-body; no return values.
Wrapper delegates frame/state-expression to RegisterAttributeDriver; permission remains a runtime obligation.
Category IDs come from an incrementing numeric counter; GetID and GetName return owned fields.
Settings delegates canvas category/subcategory registration, addon registration and opening to native inbound/settings utility boundaries.
Canvas registration returns the category and created canvas layout through secure attribute results.
Canvas layout stores and returns the supplied native frame.
Start/FinishLoopingSound store NewTicker results and CancelLoopingSound calls their Cancel methods.
SOUNDKIT is a string-keyed table of numeric sound kit IDs.
AddMessage accepts message and optional RGB, then any additional caller-owned message data.
StartFlash stores C_Timer.NewTimer result in FlashTimer; ClearFlashTimer calls its Cancel method.
RunNextFrame schedules C_Timer.After(0, callback) and returns no values.
String-name array resolves global frames for Escape dismissal.

CompactUnitFrame_SetUnit assigns displayedUnit from the supplied unit token and clears it on release; visibility updates assign unitExists literal true/false. Fields are optional for recycled/unbound child state.
WorldMapFrame inherits WorldMapFrameTemplate, itself based on MapCanvasFrameTemplate.

No runtime call site was found in the bounded inspected sources; this is metadata-based inference.

CreateSecondsFormatter documentation explicitly calls its result a numeric formatter. Together with DurationObject.FormatRemainingDuration accepting NumericFormatter this supports the intended native subtype; no runtime call site was found in the bounded inspected sources. This is metadata-based inference, not a verified caller observation.

reviewed_framexml.description: Reviewed public FrameXML contracts missing from generated API metadata and Questie Core; consumed native surfaces only, not a claim of complete FrameXML coverage. Implementation evidence is locked at the selected Blizzard commit.

evidence.reason: Factory returns uiMapID, Vector2D position and optional z; all three constructors retained.
Initialization gives each ChatTypeInfo entry public numeric r/g/b fields; other chat configuration fields remain outside the consumed color contract.
Defines the string-keyed chat-type table including RAID_WARNING before color initialization.
SOUNDKIT is a string-keyed table of numeric sound kit IDs.
Legacy wrapper forwards text/color/displayTime to RaidWarningUtil; only exists when loadDeprecationFallbacks is enabled, so consumers retain runtime presence checks.
Forwarded warning text, color and optional display time are passed to the warning frame.
Declares the global frame instance.
Sets DEFAULT_CHAT_FRAME to ChatFrame1.
ChatFrameTemplate is a ScrollingMessageFrame mixed with ChatFrameMixin.
ChatFrameMixin.AddMessage forwards arguments through ScrollingMessageFrameSecureMixin.
AddMessage accepts message and optional RGB, then any additional caller-owned message data.
Mixin lifecycle, optional scaling bounds, position/inset, frame-level index and passthrough button callbacks; GetMap can be nil before OnAdded or after OnRemoved.
Adds providers with OnAdded; acquires template-dependent native pins, invokes OnAcquired with arbitrary arguments and returns the common pin surface.
WorldMapFrame inherits WorldMapFrameTemplate, itself based on MapCanvasFrameTemplate.
Manager exposes native layout records/arrays and dirty-state methods; active layout/preset may be absent.
Declares manager Frame and its SaveChangesButton/RevertAllChangesButton native buttons.
Base dialog getters and open caller-defined mode tables; returned layout reuses native EditModeLayoutInfo.
Declares named dialog Frames and SaveAndProceedButton.
Wrapper delegates frame/state-expression to RegisterAttributeDriver; permission remains a runtime obligation.
Validates native frames and snippets; rejects forbidden receivers, requires explicit protection for wrap header, optional post-body; no return values.
RunNextFrame schedules C_Timer.After(0, callback) and returns no values.
String-name array resolves global frames for Escape dismissal.
General user-addon slash command callback registry is intentionally global and string-keyed.
Invokes registered callbacks with trimmed message and the edit-box receiver; second argument remains optional for addon direct invocation.
Settings delegates canvas category/subcategory registration, addon registration and opening to native inbound/settings utility boundaries.
Canvas registration returns the category and created canvas layout through secure attribute results.
Category IDs come from an incrementing numeric counter; GetID and GetName return owned fields.
Canvas layout stores and returns the supplied native frame.
StartFlash stores C_Timer.NewTimer result in FlashTimer; ClearFlashTimer calls its Cancel method.
Start/FinishLoopingSound store NewTicker results and CancelLoopingSound calls their Cancel methods.
At1981-1982 menu release executes each callback with the menu proxy and closeReason; stale supplemental annotation omits second argument.

At69 and98 Blizzard passes the string GameFontHighlight to fontString/EditBox SetFontObject. Questie Widget/UIType/Font.lua independently defines FontObject as string|Font; native SimpleFont-only argument metadata underdescribes that carrier.

CreateSecondsFormatter documentation explicitly calls its result a numeric formatter. Together with DurationObject.FormatRemainingDuration accepting NumericFormatter this supports the intended native subtype; no runtime call site was found in the bounded inspected sources. This is metadata-based inference, not a verified caller observation.

CreateManualClock documentation explicitly calls its result a time source for use with duration objects. DurationObject.SetClock accepts LuaDurationClock, resolved to LuaDurationClockObject; this supports the intended native subtype. No runtime call site was found in the bounded inspected sources; this is metadata-based inference.

Aura container Lua runs in a secure environment, while intrinsic/template XML and the explicit inbound facade load globally. The type describes public native instance methods, not access to private addon implementation globals.
AuraContainer intrinsic derives Frame; public AuraContainerInboundMixin delegates through its forbidden partition and owns enabled/unit defaults.
CustomAuraContainerTemplate instantiates AuraContainer with CustomAuraContainerInboundMixin on the public partition and private implementation separately.

Validates and copies optional caller group options, candidates and group layout; AddAuraGroup accepts unique nonempty key and native filter string and returns no values. maxFrameCount uses its numeric Lua carrier, but native validation requires a nonnegative integer or positive infinity. Candidate/geometry values remain native validated. Adding a group introduces the UntrustedLayoutScriptExecution forbidden aspect.
Public shared methods SetUnit validates a string, SetEnabled updates registrations and aura state, IsEnabled normalizes to boolean, and UpdateAllAuras is overridable.
ManagedAuraContainerSharedMixin provides the concrete UpdateAllAuras implementation inherited by CustomAuraContainerSharedMixin.
Default group options make candidate filters, initializer and layout optional; default maxFrameCount is infinity and frame initialization batches are ten.
Initializer receives the created aura frame public object table before access restrictions are applied; callbacks do not grant permission to inspect later secret aura state.
Public/native flow layout API owns spacing and geometry; group layout field validation is in CustomAuraContainer.
AuraButton intrinsic is a Button, hence a Frame. Frame provider creates this intrinsic and passes its public object table to the initialization callback before applying access restrictions.
AcquireUnitFrame creates the child via the driver and assigns UnitFrame; ReleaseUnitFrame clears it to nil. The header identifies the child as NamePlateUnitFrameMixin.

BaseNamePlateUnitFrameTemplate is a Button with NamePlateUnitFrameMixin; ordinary and forbidden NamePlateUnitFrame templates inherit it. The static shape does not grant permission to read a forbidden instance.

CompactUnitFrame_SetUnit assigns displayedUnit from the supplied unit token and clears it on release; visibility updates assign unitExists literal true/false. Fields are optional for recycled/unbound child state.
